name: Orca
description: Runs a fleet of coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex on your own subscriptions, from desktop, mobile or a remote machine.

name: CC Switch
description: Desktop app that manages providers, settings and MCP servers for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and other coding CLIs.

name: Multica
description: Self-hostable workspace where people and agents share tasks and work as one team.

name: herdr
description: Terminal workspace that runs and supervises many coding agents side by side.

name: AionUi
description: Desktop cowork app that drives OpenClaw, Hermes, Claude Code, Codex and more than 20 other CLI agents.

name: Vibe Kanban
description: Kanban board that hands tasks to Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents and lets you review what they did.

name: opcode
description: Desktop GUI for Claude Code to manage sessions, build custom agents and run them in the background.

name: Claude Squad
description: Terminal app that runs several Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode or Amp sessions in parallel, each in its own git worktree.

name: CLIProxyAPI
description: Serves coding CLIs such as Codex and Claude Code as an OpenAI-, Gemini- and Claude-compatible API.

name: Claude Code Router
description: Local gateway that routes Claude Code and other agents to the model providers you choose.

name: Open Agent API
description: Self-hosted gateway that serves Codex, Claude Code, ACP agents and its own built-in agent through OpenAI-, Anthropic- and Gemini-compatible APIs.

name: EverythingACP
description: Wraps existing CLIs and HTTP APIs as standalone ACP agents that can hand tasks to each other. macOS for now.

name: agentgateway
description: Proxy that secures and routes traffic between agents, MCP servers and model APIs.

name: E2B
description: Cloud sandboxes where agents run code and use real tools in isolation.

name: Claude Code Action
description: GitHub Action that runs Claude Code on pull requests and issues.

name: Langfuse
description: Open-source platform for tracing, evaluating and monitoring agents and LLM apps, built on OpenTelemetry.
license: MIT, with ee/ directories under a commercial license

name: Opik
description: Traces, evaluates and monitors LLM apps and agent workflows.

name: Phoenix
description: Arize's observability and evaluation tool for agents and LLM apps.
